outcome: Clinical course of pancreatitis (mild to moderate)
cohort: The study included 55 consecutive patients hospitalized for acute biliary pancreatitis related to pregnancy or the postpartum period between January 2014 and January 2018 at a single center.
finding: Acute biliary pancreatitis related to pregnancy also occurs frequently in the postpartum period, with a higher-than-expected incidence, and generally has a mild to moderate clinical course that can be successfully managed with conservative treatment.
